title: Weight-only 8-bit (GPTQ/AWQ) profile integration into regression funnel with adaptive per-layer sensitivity probes
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Integrate weight-only 8-bit quantization profiles (GPTQ + AWQ) into our nightly regression funnel and add adaptive per-layer sensitivity probes and calibration checkpoints. This ticket covers pipeline wiring, new synthetic and production-like eval sets, golden-answer delta thresholds, telemetry hooks, and canary rollback automation. We explicitly look for: numeric fidelity regressions, per-layer sensitivity outliers, hallucination rate regressions, latency/throughput regressions under batching, and degradation under mixed-precision hardware variants. Also scope: a lightweight FP8 experiment harness (exploratory) to collect comparison traces but not gated for blocking rollout. Success means automated nightly runs that surface actionable diffs, canary gating rules, and a documented runbook for on-call rollback and profile tuning.
acceptance_criteria: Nightly regression job consistently runs profiles/golden-suite for GPTQ and AWQ variants and uploads results to the quant regression dashboard
Per-layer sensitivity probe collects layer-wise delta metrics and flags layers with >3x baseline variance
Golden-answer delta thresholds (embedding cosine < 0.985 or log-prob KL > 0.02) trigger an automatic canary hold and Slack alert
Calibration workflow artifacts (calibration matrices, per-shard stats) are archived to GS and linked from the dashboard
Canary rollout policy: if any profile fails acceptance, system falls back to FP16 variant and marks the profile as blocked in the registry
Runbook with steps for manual calibration adjustments, re-run, and rollback is written and reviewed by PM/RE (linked in attachments)
steps: Wire GPTQ and AWQ profile artifacts into nightly regression runner (jobs/quant/nightly-runner)
Expand golden-suite to include long-form prompts, instruction-following, and domain-specific evals (search queries, summarization, code)
Add per-layer sensitivity probe: compute layer-wise output deltas vs FP16 baseline using token-level KL and representation cosine
Implement calibration checkpoint hooks: persist calibration matrices and apply calibration-replay to reproduce failures
Surface results in Grafana dashboard + register alerts for threshold breaches
Create canary gating: automatic hold + fallback to FP16 for failing requests during canary window
Add synthetic chaos jobs: kernel-swap, memory-pressure, and small-batch stress to surface stability regressions

notes: Design trade-offs: per-layer probes add ~12% extra CPU during regression jobs and increase storage for traces. We opted for sampling (1/10 requests) to balance cost. AWQ shows improved density but higher sensitivity at long seqs; plan is conservative canary gating rather than blanket enablement. ML team suggested layer-clipping and per-layer scale tuning as remediation.
